_note: EXAMPLE ONLY. The env_file values in this tracked file are ENVIRONMENT PLACEHOLDERS: "$MINIMAX_ENV_FILE" or "${MINIMAX_ENV_FILE}" resolve on the execution host to the operator's real env file. A REAL SECRET-FILE PATH (a literal path to a file on one machine, or a tilde user path) is not an example: it is machine specific, it discloses the operator's filesystem layout, and it must never be committed here. Point the placeholder at the real file instead. The harness expands $VAR / ${VAR} placeholders and tilde user paths before it opens the file, and it only opens a file that resolves inside an operator-supplied allowlist directory (--allowed-env-dir). Never commit a key value.
schema: critique-harness providers v1 — model is DATA, never code. Add a model by adding a config object; the loop logic does not change. Required keys per provider: provider, model_id, base_url, endpoint_style, chat_path, env_file, auth, max_tokens. auth is required and must match the endpoint_style (bearer for openai-compat, x-api-key for anthropic-compat); anthropic-compat also requires anthropic_version. Optional keys: temperature (default 0.1), retry_max_tokens (default 12000), vision, quirks (documentation only). temperature, max_tokens and retry_max_tokens must be positive numbers: a zero, a negative value, or a non-number is refused before the first paid call. The harness checks this schema, the item set, the item images, and the key file before the first paid call.

quirks: reasoning-heavy: reasoning can consume the whole token budget before the JSON is emitted (measured 25% parse-fail at 8000 in critique-run); schema-first prompt order + one 12000-token brevity retry are the standing mitigations
per-frame visual screen only: boundary-blind (judged run: erosion 3/6/12px all returned ok); never a boundary gate
quota: MiniMax Coding Plan draw, no per-call currency exposed

minimax-anthropic.vision: route PROVEN for text (the model-agnostic harness lane used the anthropic surface shape); vision on this surface tested by a proof run
quirks: same reasoning-budget risk as openai-compat surface

minimax-m3.vision: UNTESTED at config time (listed on both MiniMax model endpoints, census 2026-10-27); the harness probes it as a model_id-as-data check

openrouter.vision: Catalogue-verified image-input model (OpenRouter /models, 2026-10-27: 463 models, 308 with image input modality); :free variant = $0 per call. NOT proven on the judged set until the proof run below lands; the catalogue census had not landed at config time.
quirks: free-tier model: rate limits possible; a refused or errored call is recorded verbatim, never retried silently
env file holds a bare key with no VAR= prefix; harness load_key handles both forms
